newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL -- Chips firm on rosy book-to-bill.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL -- Chips firm on rosy book-to-bill.

text.p: Shares in U.S semiconductor makers and related stocks firmed preceding Tuesday's market as a widely-watched monthly indicator showed a continuing upswing in chip demand.
Preceding the open, Intel Corp added 1-3/8 to 125-1/4, Texas Instruments Inc rose 1/2 to 56-1/2 and Applied Materials Inc climbed 1/2 to 29-1/8.
The Semiconductor Industry Association said after Monday's market close October's book-to-bill ratio increased to 1.10 from a revised 0.98 in September.
October's reading means that for every $110 in new orders received there were $100 in shipments.

Other stocks benefitting from the news included Integrated Device Technology Inc, up 5/16 to 9-5/16, Xilinx, up 3/4 to 41-1/8, and VLSI Technology Inc which edged up to 20-1/2 from 20-1/16 before the open.
Elsewhere, Xerox Corp shares traded 3/4 higher 46 on the appeal of a Smith Barney upgrade to outperform from neutral, according to traders.
